name: High Noon Ezreal
creator: mattgicien
description:
### Preview video released !

A dusty hat, a raised bandana, and a gauntlet that smells of gunpowder. Ezreal has found his next adventure.

After seeing people on r/EzrealMains repeatedly ask for more masculine Ezreal skins, with High Noon coming up as a theme they wanted, I felt inspired to make one myself. It was something I wanted to play too, and once I’d brought it to life, I decided to share it with the community.

High Noon Ezreal reimagines the explorer as a young outlaw in League of Legends’ supernatural Wild West, with worn leather, smoldering embers, and black smoke, while keeping his familiar adventurous spirit.

This is the first release, and I plan to keep improving it over time. Feedback and suggestions are welcome!

I hope you enjoy playing him as much as I enjoyed making and playing him.
